title: Ability/skill systems: how much is declarative?
description: Hero shooters (Overwatch, Valorant) have per-character abilities with cooldowns, charges, and complex effects. How much of this is declarative (cooldown timers, charge counts, damage numbers) vs. needs engine code (projectile trajectories, area effects, custom physics)? Where is the line between 'numbers in a table' and 'needs a WASM module or engine plugin'?
